The Alignment Research Center, also called ARC, is a nonprofit research organization founded in 2021 and based in Berkeley, California, United States. According to its website, its mission is to align future machine learning systems with human interests. The organization states that it expects new techniques will be needed to align AI systems as they surpass human capabilities, and that as AI progress accelerates it may become increasingly difficult to adapt quickly enough to keep up with changing technology. It adds that the field would be better prepared with methods that could be safely scaled over many orders of magnitude, in the same way that generative pretraining and reinforcement learning have been scaled up dramatically over the last decade.

The material available on the company describes no specific AI products, and no products are tracked for it. No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for the organization. Its recorded location places it in California, where 281 cases are noted in the reference data.
